clues.it: Irene era nella 5ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Olga.
clues.en: Irene was in the 5th column, in the 1st row and in the same room as Olga.

clues.it: Olga era accanto a uno sgabello da saloon e a nord di Elena.
clues.en: Olga was beside a saloon stool and north of Elena.

clues.it: Vito era nella 10ª colonna, nella 3ª riga e a nord di Marta.
clues.en: Vito was in the 10th column, in the 3rd row and north of Marta.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a uno sgabello da saloon e a nord di Elena.
clues.en: Bruno was beside a saloon stool and north of Elena.

clues.it: Marta era nella 6ª colonna e l'unica seduta su una sedia, ma non era accanto a una sputacchiera.
clues.en: Marta was in the 6th column and the only one sitting on a chair, but was not beside a spittoon.

clues.it: Nino era nella 4ª colonna, a ovest di Vito e nell'Ufficio dello Sceriffo.
clues.en: Nino was in the 4th column, west of Vito and in the Sheriff's Office.

clues.it: Ugo era nella stessa stanza di Bruno.
clues.en: Ugo was in the same room as Bruno.

clues.it: Luca era l'unica persona su una sella, accanto a un bancone e in una stanza diversa da Marta.
clues.en: Luca was the only person on a saddle, beside a bar counter and in a different room from Marta.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Dario era nella 10ª riga, ma non era accanto a una sputacchiera.
clues.en: Dario was in the 10th row, but was not beside a spittoon.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a un abbeveratoio, a uno sgabello da saloon e a ovest di Vito.
clues.en: Elena was beside a water trough, a saloon stool and west of Vito.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
